Notes: Rogue has an empty Heal folder and no healing at all.

Description: Deal 4 damage to everything around you.
Move 2 tiles and draw a card.
Deal 3 damage and Root the target.
Gain Dodge. Apply 2 Weaken to every adjacent enemy.
Pull yourself to a distant tile.
Notes: May already be expressible as Move with a bigger TargetRange.
Engine Work: A self-pull: MoveEffect with a longer reach would nearly cover it, so check whether range alone is enough before writing anything.

Description: Move to a tile, then deal 8 damage to an adjacent enemy.
Engine Work: DashAttackEffect - shared with the Knight's Shield Charge.

Description: Three tiles damage any enemy that enters them.
Engine Work: Tile hazards - shared with Wall of Fire, but triggered on entry rather than at turn end.

Description: Move even if Rooted, and gain Dodge.
Engine Work: A status that suppresses MoveRefusal. Rooted returns a reason today and nothing overrides it.

Description: Deal 5 damage, or 10 if an ally is adjacent to the target.
Notes: The most grid-native idea here: it makes positioning pay off directly.
Engine Work: A conditional damage effect reading board state at resolve time - the first card whose value depends on where everyone is standing.

Description: Deal 3 damage and double your next attack.

Notes: Rogue has an empty Buff (Offensive) folder.

Description: Apply 3 Poison to everything within 2 tiles of the target.
Deal 4 damage, plus 3 more for each card played before it this turn.
Notes: Cheap, and it makes hand order matter for the first time.
Engine Work: A cards-played-this-turn counter on Character, reset on turn start, read through ActionContext.

Description: Your attacks apply 1 Poison this turn.
Notes: Probably the cheapest new status on this whole list.
Engine Work: A status with an OnDealDamage hook that also applies Poison. OnDealDamage exists and already returns DamageInfo, so this is a small addition.

Description: Kill a target below 20% health outright.
Engine Work: An execute effect reading the target's health ratio at resolve time.
DiscardEffect plus a way to choose which card - the first card needing a secondary selection UI.
Exhaust keyword - shared with the Knight's Exhausting Charge.

Description: Whenever you kill an enemy this turn, draw a card and gain 1 energy.
Notes: OnKill unlocks a whole archetype and nothing else provides it.
Engine Work: An OnKill notification. Nothing observes a death today.

Description: Enemies cannot target you until you attack.
Engine Work: An untargetable flag TargetSelector honours. Taunt already proves targeting can be overridden - ForcedQuarry is the hook to mirror.

Description: Deal damage equal to the target's missing health, up to 10.
Engine Work: Scaling damage read off the target - same machinery as the Knight's Judgement, aimed the other way.

Description: Play a copy of the last card you played this turn.
Engine Work: Card-play history plus re-resolution - shared with the Mage's Spell Echo.

Description: The target attacks its own allies next turn.
Engine Work: A status that flips ally/enemy in TargetSelector for one character. EnemyBrain picks its own target, so this needs a hook there too.

Description: Deal 8 damage and apply 3 Poison to everything within 2 tiles.
Move, gain 3 Dodge charges, and draw 2.
Summon a totem that poisons nearby enemies.
Notes: Same near-free win as the Knight's Banner of Valor.
Engine Work: A Totem prefab with a Poison aura and AuraAudience.Enemies. AuraData supports this already - it needs authoring, not code.

Description: Deal 7 damage to everything around you.
Gain 3 Strength and 2 Dodge charges, then draw 2.

Notes: Poison decays by 1 a turn, so 10 stacks is 55 damage over 10 turns - check this against the curve before shipping.
